# ADR-006: Keep private ABI, wire and platform gates open

Status: unresolved_product_requirements

Concerns: Q-interfaces, Q-platforms

## Decision

Retain established private Blue/stream and full platform obligations even though portable JSON and C wrappers build locally.

## Rationale

Neither alternative satisfies the user's parity contract.

## Alternatives

Treat portable formats as binary-compatible; drop inaccessible configurations.

## Consequences

Local Linux linked consumers and a clean wheel installation are observations. Original Carbon dependencies, the Windows/macOS matrix, complete notices and authenticated deployment remain required.
